examples.interaction: Membrane-side recognition of a TGN38-derived YxxPhi peptide by a pre-open AP2 core
examples.limits: 6YAF is a 9.1-A subtomogram-fitted core and six-residue cargo peptide from a reconstituted system. AP2 hinges/appendages and PIP2 molecules are not atomically resolved here. The path starts in a pre-open conformation; no activation, uptake completion or kinetics is inferred.
